title: Why 1 + 3 + … + 11 = 36
description:
See why 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 11 = 6² by wrapping L-shaped layers around a square.

• Start with a single square.
• Wrap 3 more squares around it to make a 2 by 2 square of 4.
• Wrap 5 more squares around it to make a 3 by 3 square of 9.
• Wrap 7 more squares around it to make a 4 by 4 square of 16.
• Wrap 9 more squares around it to make a 5 by 5 square of 25.
• Wrap 11 more squares around it to make a 6 by 6 square of 36.
• Adding the first 6 odd numbers always gives a perfect square: 6 squared.

Result: 1 + 3 + … + 11 = 6² = 36.
